coverage.cyclic: All valid twists for orders 1 through 64.
coverage.products: All ordered two- and three-factor tuples with orders 1,2,3,4,6,8,9,10,12,15,16 and all valid twists.
coverage.complex_layer: Every binary twist for zero through five degree-two generators; verifies D_w squared=0 and ker obstruction=image incoming.
coverage.limitation: Arithmetic checks of the quotient and polynomial exactness; topological inputs and local equivalences require their separate proofs.
